messages.subject: Saudi Arabia / UAE Executive Leadership | Energy, ESG and Country Strategy
messages.body:
Dear Vitalé Executive Search Team,

Your GCC executive-search work across C-suite, VP and Director appointments, with particular depth in the UAE and Saudi Arabia and active mandates across energy and professional services, makes this a relevant introduction.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit spans senior government and regulatory relations, ESG and sustainability, external and corporate affairs, strategic partnerships, social performance, executive advisory and cross-functional country-facing delivery within a major gold-mining operation.

Across 12+ years, my experience spans multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations. My current work sits where executive leadership, ministries, regulators, communities, investment priorities, energy transition and complex operating environments intersect.

Saudi Arabia is my first GCC priority, followed by the UAE. I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Country Leadership, External or Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, ESG and Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Chief of Staff and Executive Operations mandates across energy, natural resources, infrastructure and industrial development. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

I would welcome consideration for current or upcoming GCC leadership searches aligned with this profile. My Gulf-focused executive CV is attached.

Preferred reply/contact: ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
